'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Chris Terwilliger LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2010 Players Committee sheet. Copies listed on separate numbered lines; ditto marks expanded to the card above. Unreadable slots are blank numbered lines. (V) follows the sheet checkbox. Deck name Y4; eltwigg (Brian Terwilliger) identified this as Chris's Day 3 Light.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
